body: Compute restricted B_i and the linear response on their common radical using acquired ANFs. Prefix balance from the permutation promise converts coset inclusion plus dimension equality to complete-fibre equality. The restricted kernel is independent of the chosen parent origin. During acquisition use the actual request witness and filter only the gap since the last certified carrier. After expiry enumerate a complement for the next block along only the requested branch. No latent frame or full context tree is supplied. The common-control symbolic family has g_cond=1 versus global g=2m under affine input hiding; this separates cost parameters, not ordinary algorithm classes.
